Issue.label: Inventory Issue / Consumption
Issue.description: Stock consumed in production, sold to a customer, or transferred out — COGS/consumption account debited, inventory account credited.

401.detail: Vendor payable (401) credited on an inventory issue — should credit inventory account (311-371). Check Inventory Posting Profile.

Receipt.label: Inventory Receipt
Receipt.description: Stock received from a supplier or from production — inventory account debited, interim receipt or payable account credited.

401.detail: Trade payable (401) used for a receipt accrual — uninvoiced receipts should use 408. The AP invoice matching will fail.

Transfer.label: Inventory Transfer
Transfer.description: Movement of stock between warehouses, locations, or legal entities — inventory account debited (destination) and credited (source) with same value.

Adjustment.label: Inventory Adjustment
Adjustment.description: Write-up or write-down of inventory following a physical count or valuation change.
